name: Advanced Books
description: Advanced book and comic features for Jellyfin 12, including Komga-compatible One-Shots and an Advanced Reader.
overview: Komga-compatible book handling and an advanced comic reader for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Redesign the Advanced Reader UI for desktop and mobile. Add auto-hiding reader chrome, a direct page scrubber in every layout, responsive settings sheets, corrected Jellyfin detail-button markup, and an optional fullscreen toggle. Vertical Continuous and Webtoon now support fit controls, persisted zoom, side padding, page gaps, Ctrl+wheel zoom, two-finger pinch zoom, and desktop drag panning while retaining native one-finger scrolling.

Add dedicated two-finger pinch-to-zoom for paged Advanced Reader modes. Pinch gestures render a smooth live preview, suppress accidental page-turn swipes, and commit the final zoom through the reader's existing controls so persisted per-user zoom stays synchronized.
